ms.report:
In this milestone, we focused on integrating Transaction Chaining (TxChaining) capabilities into the Nami wallet and verifying the need for any updates to the Cardano Node itself. We have successfully implemented the required changes to Nami and created a working demo to showcase TxChaining functionality. Through detailed testing and development, we identified that the Cardano Node already natively supports TxChaining, making any node-level changes unnecessary for the scope of this project.
Instead, the focus shifted to verifying that tools interacting directly with the Node—such as ogmios and blockfrost—support TxChaining. To demonstrate this, we created a custom script using PyCardano that showcases a successful TxChain. Furthermore, the Nami Wallet now supports additional developer-friendly features, including a getMempoolTxs function and Mempool History tracking. This implementation allows developers to create more advanced transaction verification and inspection mechanisms.
Key Deliverables:
・Nami Wallet Enhancements:
・Added getMempoolTxs functionality to the Nami Wallet connector, allowing for real-time access to pending transactions.
・Implemented Mempool History support in Nami, enabling the wallet to show the status of transactions in the mempool as part of its history.
・Demo and Documentation:
・A demo video demonstrating that A) showcases our txChaining-version of Nami Wallet with mempool support, and B) documents how to submit chained transactions via our pycardano tools (all txs ending up in same block on-chain).
・Open tools using ogmios and blockfrost via pycardano to show TxChaining in action, with step-by-step instructions for replication (see README of repo below).
・Example PreProd Transactions:

ms.report:
Based on our assessments in previous milestones, we determined that some additional requirements are needed, and that other initially planned steps are not. Below we summarize these again:
Project Implementation Adjustments
・Milestone revealed that:
・No Changes to Cardano-Node Required: The Cardano Node inherently (but in somewhat hidden/unaccessible manner) supports TxChaining, so no modifications were needed.
・CIP Proposal Unnecessary: Since the node already supports TxChaining, submitting a CIP was not required.
・Obsolete Planned Steps: The following initially planned steps became unnecessary:
・Forking and modifying the Cardano-Node.
・Drafting and submitting a CIP, and participating in CIP discussions related to node changes.
・Executed Steps: Despite these adjustments, we successfully completed the following:
・Enhancements to Nami Wallet
・Implemented TxChaining features, including the getMempoolTxs function and Mempool History tracking, enhancing real-time access to pending transactions. We prepared and submitted a Pull Request to the Nami wallet repository detailing our enhancements: Nami Wallet PR.
・NOTE: We acknowledge that this PR has unfortunately not yet been merged. However, please note that after our latest commit it can be seen that all checks have passed. We have contacted and tried to initiate the discussion with the devs, but it seems like the repository has not had any activity for more than 2 months.. We will continue the discussion and hope to eventually get it merged but we kindly ask for milestone approval before, as this is expected to take a while and we have completed the necessary steps from our side.
・Testing and Documentation
・Conducted thorough testing of the Nami wallet enhancements to ensure reliability. Detailed testing procedures and results are documented in our Project Closeout Report: Project Closeout Report and demonstrated in our Project Closeout Video.
